message:
fix: the gallery button did nothing — missing config plugins, and a silent cancel

LIVE DEFECT #2, fast path.

CAUSE, found in the repo rather than inferred from the symptom: app.json's
plugins array held only expo-font and ios.infoPlist was empty, while
package.json carried expo-camera AND expo-image-picker — both of which ship
config plugins that inject the iOS usage descriptions (read in their own bytes:
withImagePicker.js:50-55, withCamera.js:9-13).

Autolinking pulls the native code in; only the plugin supplies the permission
strings. Without NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription iOS refuses to present the photo
library and launchImageLibraryAsync resolves canceled:true with NO UI — a button
that looks dead. expo-camera was equally undeclared, so the next native build
would have had no camera permission either: the gallery report surfaced a defect
already sitting under the working camera.

A SECOND, SEPARATE HOLE IN MY OWN CODE made it invisible: pickShot returns
'cancelled' both when he backs out and when the picker never opened, and
pickPhoto had no branch for it, so the screen did not move. That is the
dead-input family this codebase warns about, walked into by the file that warns
about it. A pick that brings nothing back now says so, in an info tone, because
backing out is normal.

FIXES: both plugins declared with French permission sentences (REQUIRES A NEW
NATIVE BUILD); studio.aucune_photo, true whichever of the two happened; and a
gate requiring every dependency whose plugin injects a UsageDescription to be
declared, detected from the plugin's own bytes rather than a hand-kept list.
RED-PROVEN against the exact app.json that shipped.

REPORTED NOT FILLED: expo-updates and expo-file-system also ship plugins and are
undeclared. Neither injects a usage description. expo-updates is deliberately
CI-configured and declaring it could conflict with the working update channel;
expo-file-system is an open question I did not answer.

GAP NAMED: the permission sentences live in app.json, not the i18n catalog, so
the copy-lint never sees them. The gate asserts French and no-English as a floor.

VERIFIED: typecheck 11/11 · supplier-app 463/463 (37 files) · copy-lint 267
entries 0 violations · ALL GATES GREEN.
